title: GateTS: Versatile and Efficient Forecasting via Attention-Inspired routed Mixture-of-Experts
abstract: arXiv:2508.17515v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Accurate univariate forecasting remains a pressing need in real-world systems, such as energy markets, hydrology, retail demand, and IoT monitoring, where signals are often intermittent and horizons span both short- and long-term. While transformers and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures are increasingly favored for time-series forecasting, a key gap persists: MoE models typically require complicated training with both the main forecasting loss and auxiliary load-balancing losses, along with careful routing/temperature tuning, which hinders practical adoption. In this paper, we propose a model architecture that simplifies the training process for univariate time series forecasting and effectively addresses both long- and short-term horizons, including intermittent patterns. Our approach combines sparse MoE computation with a novel attention-inspired gating mechanism that replaces the traditional one-layer softmax router. Through

translated_title: GateTS：通过注意力启发的路由混合专家实现多功能高效预测
translated_abstract: 准确的单变量预测在能源市场、水文、零售需求和物联网监控等现实系统中仍然是迫切需求，这些系统中的信号往往是间歇性的，且预测范围同时涵盖短期和长期。虽然Transformer和混合专家架构在时间序列预测中日益受到青睐，但一个关键差距依然存在：MoE模型通常需要复杂的训练，既要使用主预测损失又要使用辅助负载均衡损失，还需要仔细调整路由和温度参数，这阻碍了其实际应用。在本文中，我们提出了一种模型架构，简化了单变量时间序列预测的训练过程，并有效解决了包括间歇性模式在内的长期和短期预测问题。我们的方法将稀疏MoE计算与一种新颖的注意力启发门控机制相结合，取代了传统的单层softmax路由器。通过……
tldr: 提出GateTS模型，用注意力启发的门控机制取代传统单层softmax路由器，简化了混合专家时间序列预测模型的训练，无需复杂的辅助损失和参数调优，即可有效处理包括间歇性模式在内的长短期预测任务。
en_tdlr: GateTS simplifies MoE-based univariate time-series forecasting by replacing the traditional softmax router with an attention-inspired gating mechanism, effectively handling both long- and short-term horizons including intermittent patterns without complicated auxiliary losses or routing/temperature tuning.
